research.notes: No registry (CA SOS, SAM.gov) record was checked or confirmed, and no page links this firm to OUSD. The agenda title says 'Catalyst Environmental Services', while a different firm, Catalyst Environmental (catenv.com, Hayward, CA, hazardous waste and remediation contractor), also exists. The agenda's Santa Monica location and the 'Solutions' name favor ce.solutions, but a reviewer should confirm. The website's contact page lists a Sherman Oaks mailing address, not Santa Monica.

profile.summary: Catalyst Environmental Solutions is an environmental consulting firm. It works on energy, land development and remediation, and water resources, and helps public and private clients with environmental impact analysis, permitting, site cleanup and compliance.
